notes.title: Version 1.1.1 of Sliding Rails is now live.
notes.content:
First update in years!
Version 1.1.1 of Sliding Rails is now live.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Windowed mode added
[*] Whistle speed increased
[*] BGM updated
[*] Exit game button added
[/list]

I understand music is a matter of taste, so feel free to share your thoughts in reviews or on the community board.
If I receive feedback, I'll do our best to improve it.

Thank you for continuing to support Sliding Rails!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 is now available.
notes.content:
Version 1.0.7 is now available.

Shortcuts have been added.
In the game screen:
- Press S to skip
- Press R to retry
- Press E to return to home
- Press W for the train whistle
- Press Q to exit the game

notes.title: Update on September 20th
notes.content:
We've fixed the issue where the language setting on the stage selection screen was not reflecting changes made to the language setting immediately after alteration.

We will continue to make improvements in the future. 
if you encounter any issues or have suggestions for enhancements, please post them on the community bulletin board.

notes.title: Update for August 13th.
notes.content:
Update for August 13th.
Updates were made by selecting those that could be addressed based on player feedback.

[list]
[*]Added the ability to skip the stage direction at the beginning of the stage, which confirms the start, goal, and midpoint.
[*]Added explanation to the option "Fix Time.
[/list][*]Added a description for the option to fix the time.

We will continue to reflect the feedback we receive.
Thank you for your support of Sliding Rails.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Updates on August 6th
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added BGM for morning, evening, and night.
[*]Obtaining stars now triggers environmental changes.
[*]Fixed text in the settings screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update plan for 8/6 : To improve the atmosphere of the game.
notes.content:
Those are great suggestions to improve the game's atmosphere!

Adding BGM for different times of the day (morning, evening, and night) can enhance the player's experience, creating a more immersive environment.
Additionally, implementing changes in the environment when the player collects stars will add a rewarding aspect to the game.

It's also commendable to address minor issues, such as fixing text in the settings screen, as it shows attention to detail and improves the overall user experience.

Keep accepting proposals to make the game even better! Players' feedback and ideas can be valuable for continuous improvement and creating an enjoyable gaming experience.
